_readme: Cairo-runtime counterfactual-derivation fixture (fund-safety gate). Minted by the #[ignore]d print_derived_deploy_vector test in packages/contracts/src/test_sol_account.cairo: it declares SolAccount and deploys it with deploy_from_zero at salt = poseidon([low, high]) and constructor calldata [low, high] (the TS vector's pubkey = bytes 0..31 as a little-endian u256), then panics with (class_hash, address). The oracle declares the CURRENT contract source, so this class_hash is the sol_account class the source builds, which is exactly the single pinned class hash in @starkware-libs/anystark-core (there is no separate deploy/latest split). key_to_address.test.ts cross-checks that @starkware-libs/anystark-core's deriveSolAccountAddress(PUBKEY, class_hash).address equals `address`, binding starknet.js's calculateContractAddressFromHash + deployer=0 to the Cairo runtime's real deployment. key_to_address.test.ts also asserts this class_hash equals the pinned sol_account class hash (its staleness guard), so a stale fixture from an old contract build fails loudly rather than passing on a self-consistent-but-stale pair. PROVENANCE (load-bearing): BOTH class_hash and address in this file MUST be minted from the Cairo print_derived_deploy_vector output (the independent oracle). Do NOT paste gen_derivation_vector.mjs output here: that script is TS-derived (the same starknet.js path key_to_address.test.ts asserts), so using it would make the TS cross-check tautological (TS vs TS) and silently drop the contract-address-formula guard. Regenerate: cd packages/contracts && snforge test --ignored print_derived_deploy_vector. NOTE: the panic prints felt252 values in DECIMAL; convert class_hash and address to hex (e.g. num.toHex) before committing them here, since this file stores hex.
